name: Forced displacement
summary: No new event displacing 500,000 in a month found as of 8 Nov; Sudan's long-running crisis continues
state: Searches on 8 Nov found no single new event displacing more than 500,000 people within a month. Sudan's displacement crisis is long-running rather than new; on 14 Sep IOM warned that its shelter and relief stocks there were running out for lack of funds (UN News). Because this is an absence of reports and agency dashboards could not be opened on 8 Nov, Normal is kept on the previous assessment.
for_you: People displaced in Sudan and neighbouring countries remain the most exposed. Host communities and aid agencies carry much of the strain.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month found as of 8 Nov; Watch line is 500,000 in a month.
